title: force fields sci-fi series
description: adds a portable force field that protects you from some damage
body:
this datapack adds a force field generator that protect you from harm

when you get hit it absorbs the damage, but after that you need to wait 1.5 seconds for it to absorb damage again
(hold it in any hand for it to work)
